evaluation.cache: one loaded graph and per-family results per pipeline instance; callers provide immutable snapshots
evaluation.fallback: 30 in-game minutes since last full or fallback reconciliation; no constant polling in this package
evaluation.gameThread: live SMAPI reader must capture world/actor state on required game thread; no worker game reads
evaluation.ui: consume returned immutable tasks; never reevaluate display

taskIdentity.daily: hash family/location/crop/method, plus day in snapshot identity
taskIdentity.achievement: hash action type and qualified item ID or recipe record ID across all selected achievement roots
taskIdentity.alternatives: route references and candidate locations are ordered choices, not separate tasks

completion: crops: selected tiles no longer ready/dry after freshly observed changes (do not call these historically completed without evidence)
shipping: processed shipping history, not pending bin
cooking: observed recipe completion history; unlock alone insufficient
unknowns: missing current fish spawn or access predicate
unobserved unreserved stock or recipe ingredient allocations
limitations: Current game content not available; synthetic fixtures do not validate C# readers
partial caller-supplied snapshots must not be mistaken for complete world scans
